concerns.text: T015 implements 'majority training, minority hold-out' split logic. Spec FR-009 explicitly defines the split ratio as '[deferred]' and requires the system to split data but does not mandate a specific 'majority/minority' heuristic. The task hardcodes a specific implementation strategy not present in the spec, potentially violating the requirement to keep the ratio deferred until data characteristics are known.

T010 and T042 instruct the system to 'IMMEDIATELY invoke generate_synthetic.py' and 'Do not raise an error' when real data is missing. Spec FR-007 and FR-008 explicitly mandate that the system MUST halt with error codes EX_DATA_INTEGRITY or EX_POWER_INSUFFICIENT if paired samples < 100 (implying real data failure should stop the pipeline). The tasks implement a silent fallback to synthetic data which directly contradicts the mandatory halt requirement for the default 'Scientific Mode' defined in the plan and spec.

FR-005 requires permutation testing on the independent hold-out set. T018 (US1) implements this logic, and T033 (US3) re-implements the exact same logic (n=1000, seed=42, same formula) on the same internal hold-out set. There is no single task covering this requirement; instead, it is duplicated across phases, creating ambiguity on which task satisfies the spec and risking inconsistent implementation.

SC-002 requires 'at least 10 SNPs and 10 metabolites remain significant' as a measurable outcome. T028b only 'logs the count to the console and reports in JSON'. The task lacks a mechanism to verify this success criterion or flag a failure if the threshold is not met, leaving the SC-002 requirement unverified by the task list.

T063 implements 'biological pathway enrichment analysis' using KEGG/GO. This functionality is not mentioned in any Functional Requirement (FR) or Success Criterion (SC) in the spec. This is a stale tag/scope creep task referencing a requirement that does not exist in the current spec.
